description: Search Lakpura tours, day-trips and experiences by keyword. Returns each match with a slug, title, rating and its public page URL. Call get_service with a slug to see bookable options and price, then start_booking to book. Optional kind filter: "multi_day" (multi-day tours) or "single_day".

query.description: Keyword(s) to match against the tour title (e.g. "whale watching", "sigiriya", "safari"). Omit to browse top-rated.

name: search_tours
